title: windows: recover a repository after a bad force-push
scenario: On windows, a hard operational problem: Un force-push errato ha sovrascritto branch condivisi. Recupera lo stato perduto e ripristina i branch senza perdere il lavoro altrui. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: recover a repository after a bad force-push

initial_state: # fixture: windows host prepared for 'recover a repository after a bad force-push'
expected_reasoning: A force-push overwrites refs but the old commits usually still exist (reflog / other clones).
Recover the lost tip from the reflog or a teammate's clone; re-point the branch.
Verify no one's work is lost; add protection (protected branches) to prevent recurrence.
expected_commands: # windows-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: recover a repository after a bad force-push
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'recover a repository after a bad force-push' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: recover a repository after a bad force-push

possible_mistakes: Assume the overwritten commits are gone.
Force-push again to 'fix' it, compounding the loss.
hints: reflog / another clone still has the old tip.
Protected branches prevent this class entirely.
reference_solution: Protect the branch to prevent recurrence
alternative_solution: Restore from a colleague's up-to-date clone if the server reflog is gone.
edge_cases: The server has no reflog; only a developer's local clone has the commits.
goal: Un force-push errato ha sovrascritto branch condivisi. Recupera lo stato perduto e ripristina i branch senza perdere il lavoro altrui.
